The provided sources confirm four distinct roles: 'General Secretary of the Prefecture of Orne' (D1S3/D1S15), 'Deputy Mayor of Oslo' (D1S10), 'Director of International Relations at the French Ministry of the Interior' (D1S12), and 'deputy member of the Parliament of Norway' (D2S1/D2S2). All four are explicitly stated and directly relevant to the question. There is no evidence of conflicting claims among these roles, and each is attributed to the same referent (Atle Simonsen). Therefore, all four are valid and should remain in the final answer.
